mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger immediate risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad-based demand contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% YoY), the Federal Reserve's delayed tightening response leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 6.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months signals robust labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS increased over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 in a 3-month window, it indicates manufacturing contraction and supply chain stress, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 5.0% YoY and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 1.0%, the Fed is perceived as behind the curve, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In housing boom regimes (HOUST > 2000 thousand units), strong housing demand supports consumer spending and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST exceeds 2000, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
